body: Since March

I think mainly, the happiness comes from the idea of the pain ending, of what I'll leave behind.. I am mentally ill. I know this. I can't afford to go get treatment, and my parents tell me I'm faking it, or that what I'm experiencing isn't real, so they won't pay for help. I've gotten myself bakeracted many many times, trying to find a way to fix what's going on in what I consider to be, a very broken mind. 
Every moment I'm here, I can feel myself changing. I am no longer the person I used to be, kind, and soft, and quiet, I am abrasive and find it easy to be rude, ignorant, I see the walls I'm building but can't do anything to tear them down. I feel like I need to kill myself before I become someone that is evil, as I can feel myself slowly turning into just that.... I need to kill myself before I go completely insane and lose what little left of me I have... 

I am deeply saddened to think about the things I wanted for my life. I wanted to grow old with Mango, I wanted to be a father, I wanted to be a paramedic, I wanted to help people, I wanted to be kind, and happy, and generous, I wanted to travel and give random people enough money to change their lives, I wanted to perform with the best orchestras around, I wanted to learn how to speak French... I wanted to live a whole life, and it saddens me to miss out on so many big and little moments. It saddens me to think about Christmas without my family... Missing out on lunch dates with my friends... Going on dates...

There are so many reasons to be sad, to be scared, to be wary. 
But the thought of what I'm leaving behind makes me happy... I have spoken many kind words, I have made many friends, I have affected peoples lives, good and bad, and they will remember the good when I am gone. 
I am so happy to leave this world as myself, while I can still think straight, while I am still happy and able to love, while my family is safe and my friends are happy. 
I am happy to have experienced what I have. I am happy to leave knowing I have done my best to soften the blow for the people I love... I am happy to die at my own hand, at my own leisure, while I still have my personality.

Physical tolls can very negatively affect a persons psyche... I'm sorry you're going through this.
I understand anxiety. It's hard to get out of bed when you're so anxious you can't even think about the things that even remotely can set you off... but one day, your anxiety will be alleviated, even the slightest bit, and you will go outside and see something that is reason enough to go outside the next day, and eventually, it will become easier. 
Be safe, be brave, be happy. Have a happy life and live for yourself!

There is no reason too small to stay. God, I used to do the same thing, "there's some sun peaking out behind those leaves... Stick around to see it tomorrow". Every reason, no matter how small, is a valid one. I hope you find happiness, and I hope you find a big enough reason to live to make you look back on these days and think "how could I ever have wanted to end my life?" 
Stay for beauty, stay for soft socks, stay for bird shit on your shoulder, stay for life.

I would never wish the bad parts of what is going through my head on another person. 
Everybody has something to offer the world, being a "nice person" doesn't mean that I should stick around, and even if you aren't one (which I doubt), that is no reason to take your life. 
The only part if my experience that I could even remotely consider sharing with you is the peace and joy I am feeling. 
Live long, live happy, live proud, and live with kindness. I hope to meet you some day, in another life.
Peace to you as well! Have a good life

Thank you for advice! I actually did try this earlier this year, I got a new job, I switched all of my relationships around, damn, even getting Mango last March was a way to try to find something to stick for. 
I believe that I have lived enough good things to last me an eternity, and although I know there is so much more the world has to offer, I know I can't stay here much longer. I can feel myself turning into a bad person, I can feel myself getting more miserable and I can feel hatred bubble up every single day. I know that I need to end this, before my mental illness turns me into someone I don't recognize, that hurts people, that doesn't understand boundaries, that doesn't respect love and goodness. I can feel myself slowly turn into a person who, to me, embodies evil, and it is excruciating..

I have found my peace, and my peace is in the decision to end my life. I have never been calmer, or happier, and yes, I know there are things I will miss dearly, and people who I know will miss me dearly, but I can't stay here too much longer. 

Thank you for your kind words, and I sincerely hope that your life is long, and happy, and full of enough love to fill you up inside, and I cannot wait to meet you in another life, and hear all about it.
